exportBackup.label: Export device backup
exportBackup.summary: Encrypted copy of this device’s keys

restoreBackup.label: Restore device backup
restoreBackup.summary: Load device keys from an encrypted backup file

endpoint.ownerSummary: Point all devices to the server’s new address
endpoint.memberSummary: Use a signed update to reach the server’s new address

remove.label: Remove or uninstall
remove.summary: Forget on this device or uninstall from the VPS

operation.interruption: Services restart, so other devices may briefly disconnect.

backup.title: Back up VPS
backup.summary: Encrypted copy of server settings and access

steps.read: Server settings and access are read over verified SSH.
steps.encrypt: The backup is encrypted with your password and saved on this device.

restore.title: Restore or migrate VPS
restore.summary: Restore a backup on this or a new VPS

steps.choose: You choose a VPS backup and verify the target VPS over SSH.
steps.review: You review what will be replaced before anything changes.

update.title: Update VPS software
update.summary: Install a newer SirinVPN release on the VPS

steps.review: You review the signed release before it’s installed.
steps.rollback: The current release is kept for rollback.

repair.title: Repair VPS configuration
repair.summary: Reapply networking and services on the VPS

steps.reapply: Networking, services and DNS are reapplied, and the server software is reinstalled.
steps.preserve: Devices and access are kept. You review DNS changes first.

steps.choose: You choose DNS servers or private records for every device on this server.
steps.apply: Changes are applied with a repair, which reinstalls the server software.

review.rotationFirst: Finish this device’s key rotation first.
review.refreshFirst: Refresh this device’s VPN status first.
review.disconnectFirst: Disconnect the VPN on this device first. Other devices aren’t affected.
review.disconnectFirstKillSwitch: Disconnect the VPN on this device first. This lifts its kill switch and stops automatic reconnect.
review.disconnectFailed: Couldn’t disconnect the VPN. Try again.

health.title: System health
health.diagnosticsSummary: Checks this device and, while connected, DNS, traffic leaks and the server.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Current state of this device and server. Results aren’t saved.
diagnostics.copied: Report copied. It stays in your clipboard until replaced.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the report. Check clipboard access and try again.
diagnostics.passedNote: Passing checks don’t rule out every possible leak.

report.title: SirinVPN diagnostics
report.scope: Current state only. No activity history.

speedTest.title: Speed test to your VPS
speedTest.description: Measures download, upload and latency through the VPN to your own VPS over one connection, so it isn’t your internet speed. It takes about 20 seconds and briefly slows the VPN for everyone. The result stays on this device.
speedTest.running: Measuring the tunnel to your VPS…
speedTest.failed: The speed test didn’t finish. Check that this device is connected, then try again.

error.unsavedSettings: Save or discard your changes in Settings, then connect.
error.settingsNotLoaded: Connection settings aren’t loaded yet. Open Settings and try again.
error.connectionChange: The connection didn’t change. Refresh the status and try again.
error.stopUnconfirmed: The VPN didn’t confirm it stopped. Check its status.
error.resume: Couldn’t resume. Your traffic settings are unchanged.
error.diagnostics: Couldn’t run diagnostics. Refresh the status and try again.
